summary: Server one-frame script command: interrupt the Anubis behaviour of an entity. The command handler creates a helper entity with this component; ls::anubis's interrupt step (bg3.exe+0x382B500) queues the target when it still has ls::anubis::RuntimeComponent. Never seen alive.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x38AF1A0 creates a new entity and writes the 8-byte value of its argument into the component (AllocRaw 8, no destructor). bg3.exe+0x382B500 reads each row (stride 8), checks it as a valid entity handle (<0x41 type bits, not 0xFFC0000000000000), tests the entity for ls::anubis::RuntimeComponent and adds it to a set of entities to interrupt.
